content.text: In Cameroon, digital creators face a critical barrier: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-3|payment]] gateways like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This leaves you unable to sell your ebooks, courses, or templates to a global audience. But what if you could own your commerce infrastructure? What if you could deploy a system that processes [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-2|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-actually-2|Crypto Payments]] payments automatically, delivers products instantly, and gives you full data ownership—all without relying on third-party platforms? This is not a workaround. It’s sovereign infrastructure. Built to withstand geographic restrictions. Designed to give you control. Here’s how to deploy it today.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment gateways fail you because they operate on centralized systems that exclude regions like Cameroon. They rely on banking networks that impose arbitrary restrictions. This infrastructure is different. It’s built on decentralized blockchain networks and open-source tools. Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. Supabase stores orders securely. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. The system is permissionless. It doesn’t ask where you’re from. It doesn’t care about your local currency. It processes transactions on networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON—where fees are under $0.10. You own the code. You control the data. This isn’t a platform. It’s your stack. Deployed once, it’s yours forever.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather three things. First, your digital products. Organize them in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Second, a domain name. Buy one from Cloudflare Registrar or use a free subdomain. Third, a crypto wallet. Set up a Metamask or Trust Wallet to receive payments. You don’t need technical expertise, but you do need clarity. Know your product URLs. Decide which cryptocurrencies to accept. Choose your preferred blockchain network for low fees. If you’re starting from zero, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates. It’s not required, but it saves weeks of trial and error. This is not a plugin. It’s infrastructure. Treat it with the seriousness it deserves.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with hosting. Deploy your storefront to Cloudflare Pages. It’s free and globally distributed. Connect Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Write a script to verify payments via NOWPayments API. When payment confirms, trigger a download link from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to log orders. Configure webhooks in NOWPayments to automate the process. Test each step manually. Send a test payment. Ensure the product delivers. This pipeline is modular. You can swap components later. For example, replace Google Sheets with Airtable. Or switch from BSC to Solana for faster transactions. The key is ownership. Every tool is either free or pay-as-you-go. No subscriptions. No lock-ins.
This infrastructure is built to withstand geographic restrictions—not workaround them.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once deployed, test the system end-to-end. Send a real payment from a separate wallet. Ensure the product delivers instantly. Check your Supabase or Google Sheets for the order record. Verify the transaction on the blockchain. When it works, share your store link. Promote it to your audience. Monitor transactions via NOWPayments dashboard. For your first sale, celebrate. But don’t stop there. Document the process. Note where friction occurs. This data will guide your scaling decisions. Remember: this system is not a marketplace. It’s your private infrastructure. You’re not renting. You’re owning.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the base infrastructure live, scale methodically. Add more products to your pipeline. Expand to new cryptocurrencies. Optimize for mobile users in Cameroon and beyond. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability. Integrate analytics to track conversions. If volume increases, upgrade to Cloudflare Enterprise for higher limits. Or deploy additional instances of your stack. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook. It’s not about growth for growth’s sake. It’s about serving your audience without intermediaries. Every upgrade is an investment in your sovereignty. Every sale is a proof point. This is how you build commerce infrastructure that outlasts platforms.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

To deploy a payment gateway for digital products in Cameroon without Stripe or PayPal, use Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. Host products on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Configure webhooks to automate delivery. Test end-to-end before going live. This stack is free to deploy, with NOWPayments charging only 0.5% per transaction. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates for $197.
You own the code. You control the data. No platform dependency.

If you’re ready to deploy this infrastructure today, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints, templates, and scaling guides. It’s not required, but it eliminates guesswork. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to download instantly. This is not a course. It’s a deployment kit. Built for creators in regions where platforms fail. Designed to give you infrastructure sovereignty.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Organize your digital products in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 2. Register a domain name or use a free subdomain. 3. Set up a crypto wallet to receive payments. 4. Deploy your storefront to Cloudflare Pages. 5. Connect Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. 7. Configure webhooks to automate product delivery. 8. Test the pipeline end-to-end with a real transaction. 9. Monitor transactions via NOWPayments dashboard. 10. Document friction points for future scaling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step blueprints and templates. Follow the instructions to deploy. No coding required.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase are free tier-compatible. NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction.
Can I scale this infrastructure as my sales grow?
Yes. Upgrade to Cloudflare Enterprise for higher limits. Deploy additional instances of your stack as needed.
What happens if a payment fails?
NOWPayments automatically retries failed transactions. Configure email alerts to monitor edge cases manually.
